lesson_title: AI workloads and Azure AI vocabulary
learner_starting_state: Can run and debug a small Python file but has not yet organized AI scenarios into workload families.
learner_ending_state: Can distinguish six AI workload families, choose the best primary workload for a short scenario, and explain the Terminal's source-output-evidence state model.
mastery_gate: Score at least 10 of 12 on the closed-note workload check, with no generative-versus-agentic, vision-versus-information-extraction, or source-output-evidence critical miss.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: AI-901 scope and Microsoft capability claims trace to the current official source register; the Terminal state model is explicitly course-authored bridge instruction.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Do not infer a specific Azure product from a workload label alone; reverify volatile product availability and terminology before live implementation.

notes: Reference concept-lesson package with deterministic scenario and Terminal-state validation.
